subject: Pinned-version rollback simulation & scheduling — request for Ops window
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Park <jane.park@finx-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pinned-version rollback simulation & scheduling — request for Ops window

Team —

Finx is moving to pin our Private (VPC) deployment to v2.7.3 for Saturday 4/24. Before we commit, they asked for a coordinated rollback simulation during a maintenance window so their security and SRE can validate the emergency unpin flow. They want a live rehearsal (no traffic changes to production customers) that walks through:

- Canary traffic reroute to fallback cluster
- Automated unpin + version revert to v2.6.9 on a node pool slice
- KV cache invalidation and recovery timing
- Audit/log artifacts for SOC2 evidence

Ask: can we reserve a 2-hour ops window the week of 4/20 (preferred 4/22–4/23 evenings) for a guided drill with Finx SREs? Karthik — can you confirm whether the current pin gating rules will allow a simulated unpin on a single AZ without triggering global rollbacks? Laura — we should publish a short checklist to Finx in advance. Neha — I attached the draft rollback_playbook_v1.pdf and a canary matrix we plan to use.

Goal: perform the drill, capture timings, validate our revert playbook, and collect artifacts to attach to their audit folder.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- rollback_playbook_v1.pdf (staged playbook; sensitive)
- canary-traffic-matrix.csv (traffic slices)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pinned-version rollback simulation & scheduling — request for Ops window

+1 on the drill. A few quick notes after skimming the playbook:

- Karthik: our pin gating currently prevents cluster-wide unpin without 2/3 approvers. For a simulation we can exercise a single-AZ unpin by running the governance bypass flag in staging controllers (it logs an audit entry). Will that satisfy Finx's auditors?
- We must lock down monitoring alerts so we don't page on simulated failover. Ops on-call rota should be provided the silence window.
- Suggestion: run the rehearsal against a mirrored staging slice with a 10% canary that we then promote to a revert path — less risk to production.

If everyone agrees, I can propose two slots: Thu 2026-04-22 21:00–23:00 PT or Fri 2026-04-23 02:00–04:00 PT (to match Finx East coast SRE). Which works better for the Finx folks?

-Neha

Thanks — Finx SREs are supportive. A couple of clarifications from our side before locking a slot: 

1) SOC2 evidence: we need replayable audit logs that show the unpin action, the actor, and the pre/post cluster state (component versions). Can you confirm that the governance bypass flag is recorded as a distinct audit event and that the generated artifacts will be accessible via the shared project bucket?
2) Can you share the expected timing for the following tasks during the drill:
   - cluster unpin (single AZ)
   - node pool revert (single slice)
   - KV cache flush and rehydrate window

If those timings are within the playbook, Finx can provision a dedicated SRE to observe. Preferred date: Thu 2026-04-22 21:00 PT.

We will also need a short runbook for our change approvers to sign off during the drill (one page). Can you provide a short checklist for approvers by EOD Thursday?

—Jane
Principal SRE, Finx Payments
ops@finx-payments.com
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@finx-payments.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pinned-version rollback simulation & scheduling — request for Ops window

Jane / Finx ops —

Confirming Thu 2026-04-22 21:00–23:00 PT. We will run the drill against a mirrored staging slice (10% canary) but will exercise the governance bypass audit path so you get identical artifacts. Preliminary timing estimates (from internal dry-run):

- governance bypass + single-AZ unpin action: 30–60s (audit event CO-ACTION:unpin)
- node pool revert (10% slice): 7–10 minutes (rolling drain/recreate with pinned image)
- KV cache flush + rehydrate (slice): 3–5 minutes for cold misses; 15–20 minutes for full warmup under normal workload

I attached the rollback_playbook_v1.pdf (finalized) and canary-traffic-matrix.csv. Laura — I took your earlier checklist and condensed it to a 1-page approver checklist (see section 1.1 in the playbook). Neha — please coordinate alert silences with on-call and ensure the governance bypass flag is enabled only on the staging controllers we point the drill to.

Post-drill deliverables:
- timing spreadsheet with observed latencies
- archived audit bundle (S3 link) for Finx SOC2 folder
- list of any manual steps observed and mitigation items

See you Thursday.

-Michael
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachments:
- rollback_playbook_v1.pdf
- canary-traffic-matrix.csv
